title: Pure Doriado
summary: Pure Doriado and Elementsaber multi-Attribute build with generic staples. Elementsaber monsters discard each other to fill the GY and declare any Attribute while in the GY, turning on Elemental Saga Doriado and Elemental Grace Doriado.

summary.title: Starters
points: Palace of the Elemental Lords searches any Elementsaber monster once per turn (skipping your next Battle Phase), boosts all monsters you control by 200 ATK and DEF per different Attribute in your GY, and lets you send Elementsabers from the Deck to the GY instead of the hand to pay for Elementsaber effects once per turn.
Elementsaber Makani sends an Elementsaber from the hand (or Deck under Palace) to the GY to search any Elementsaber or Elemental Lord monster.
Elementsaber Malo sends an Elementsaber from the hand (or Deck under Palace) to the GY to dump another Elementsaber from the Deck to the GY, rapidly stacking 3 to 6 Attributes in the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Palace of the Elemental Lords + Makani / Malo
steps: Activate Palace of the Elemental Lords to search Elementsaber Makani or Elementsaber Malo, then Normal Summon Makani and use Palace's substitution to send an Elementsaber from the Deck to the GY and search Elemental Saga Doriado or Elementsaber Lapauila Mana.
Use each Elementsaber's once-per-turn GY effect to change their Attributes in the GY so you have at least three different Attributes.

Activate Elemental Saga Doriado in the hand: with 3 or more Attributes in your GY, it Special Summons itself and a monster from your GY, then Special Summons a monster with an Attribute not in your GY from the Deck, and neither player can respond to its activation.

summary.title: Attribute Manipulation & Classic Doriados
summary.text: Every Main Deck Elementsaber (Makani, Malo, Molehu, Nalu, Aina, and Lapauila) can declare any Attribute once per turn while in the GY, becoming that Attribute until the end of the turn. Elemental Mistress Doriado, Ritual Summoned with Doriado's Blessing, is simultaneously treated as WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH while face-up on the field, while Dark Doriado stacks 1 EARTH, WATER, FIRE, and WIND monster on top of the Deck on summon and boosts those four Attributes in your Pendulum Zone.

summary.title: Bosses, Control & Left out
points: Elemental Saga Doriado generates three bodies at once with unrespondable activation, setting up Link plays such as S:P Little Knight alongside your Elementsabers.

Elemental Grace Doriado Special Summons itself when 6 or more different Attributes are in the GYs, gains 500 ATK and DEF per Attribute in the GYs, and banishes 3 monsters from your GY to negate an opponent's Special Summon.

Elementsaber Lapauila Mana sends 2 monsters from the hand (or Deck under Palace) to Special Summon itself and grants all your Elementsabers battle immunity (EARTH/WIND), effect destruction immunity (WATER/FIRE), and targeting immunity (LIGHT/DARK) based on the sent monsters' original Attributes.
Elementsaber Molehu flips a monster face-down on either turn, Elementsaber Lapauila negates a Spell or Trap activation, and Elementsaber Aina revives a GY Elementsaber or Elemental Grace Doriado.
Left out: External Invoked, Magistus, and Chaos Angel packages from the page's combo lines are omitted.

main: Elemental Saga Doriado
Newest support. With three Attributes in your GY, summons itself and a monster from the GY, and summons a monster of a new Attribute from the Deck; neither can be responded to.
Dark Doriado
Summoned: stacks an EARTH, WATER, FIRE and WIND monster on top of the Deck.
Elemental Grace Doriado
Summoned with six Attributes in the GYs: grows with them, and banishes three to negate a summon.
Elemental Mistress Doriado
Ritual with Doriado's Blessing: counts as every elemental Attribute on the field.
Elementsaber Makani
Sends an Elementsaber from the hand to search an Elementsaber.
Elementsaber Malo
Sends an Elementsaber from the hand to send another from the Deck to the GY.
Elementsaber Molehu
Sends an Elementsaber from the hand to flip a monster face-down on either turn.
Elementsaber Nalu
Sends an Elementsaber from the hand to get another back from the GY.
Elementsaber Aina
Sends an Elementsaber from the hand to revive another, ignoring its conditions.
Elementsaber Lapauila
Sends an Elementsaber from the hand to negate a Spell or Trap.
Elementsaber Lapauila Mana
Sends two monsters from the hand to summon itself; the Attributes of the Elementsabers sent protect your Elementsabers from battle, effects or targeting.
Palace of the Elemental Lords
Field Spell: searches an Elementsaber (skipping your next Battle Phase), pumps your monsters per Attribute in the GY, and lets Elementsaber costs come from the Deck.
Doriado's Blessing
Ritual Spell for Elemental Mistress Doriado.
extra: Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
